description: aca.pescara.it zoominfo.com/c/aca-spa-in-house-providing/458761917 ACA Pescara public housing agency of the Province of Pescara (Abruzzo, Italy) — an ente pubblico economico created under Abruzzo's regional housing law (LR 39/1989, successor to the old IACP public-housing institutes), owned by the province and member municipalities. Its job: building, allocating and managing public/social housing (ERP) — social-rent apartments allocated by points system (family size, income, disability, eviction risk), below-market "canone moderato" housing, and residences for elderly and disabled residents. Typical ACA functions include rent collection, maintenance, public tenders/PPPs with developers, and post-earthquake reconstruction programs (a core Abruzzo role after L'Aquila 2009 and Amatrice 2016). It's a small regional body (~20–60 staff, minimal digital footprint, no public financials) — the kind of quiet public utility that runs the invisible housing layer of a mid-sized Italian province.

Financière d'Uzès offers a range of financial services tailored for individuals, entrepreneurs, and professionals, focusing on wealth management, investment strategies, and fiscal optimization. Their services include asset management, financial analysis, and dedicated funds, catering to clients looking to enhance their income, organize their assets, and manage their taxes. With over 35 years of experience and a commitment to independence, they have supported 2000 families and manage 1.5 billion euros in assets. The company operates six offices across France, providing personalized service through a single point of contact.

Aqualogus is a private engineering consulting firm that helps communities and businesses solve water-related challenges. They work closely with clients to design smart solutions for hydraulic projects, water resources management, and environmental protection. With years of hands-on experience, their team of skilled engineers creates practical plans that make a real difference in how water systems work and how we care for our environment.

Konica Minolta Bulgaria is a company with its own sales, marketing, and technical structure, and is part of the global brand specializing in innovative business and IT solutions. The company established its presence in Bulgaria in 2005 and has experienced continuous growth ever since.

Agencia Estatal de Meteorología - AEMET is a governmental agency of Spain that provides comprehensive meteorological services, including weather observation, predictions, and climate analytics. It serves various sectors such as agriculture, aviation, maritime activities, and emergency services. AEMET aims to support public safety and management through accurate weather forecasts, climate data, and educational resources. The agency also engages in research and international collaboration to enhance meteorological science and technology.

Cerámicas Kantu S.A.C. is a Peruvian company specializing in the manufacturing of decorative tiles and accessories made from ceramic, porcelain, and glass. With over 40 years of experience in the ceramic industry and more than 15 years in producing construction finishes, they offer high-quality products with innovative designs. Their intended clients include distributors and individuals looking to enhance their spaces with unique decorative elements. The company emphasizes customer service and provides assistance through their sales advisors.
